tasks.behavior: A due date keeps the invoice's checkout open until 60 days after it, and the form warns when the owner closes it earlier (D-80)
acceptance: Picking a due date sets Checkout closes after to Custom on the due date plus 60 days (capped at 364 days from today) with a line that says why; clearing it restores the default unless the owner chose the close
A close before the due date plus 60 days shows a warning beside the control that a later payment is held for the payer, not paid; the invoice can still be created
The date math is unit tested (month and year boundaries, the cap) and the merchant e2e test sees the switch and the warning; axe 0
notes: 2026-10-16 review pass by reviewer: Independent review, two rounds; date math checked every 15 minutes over 2026-2027 in 10 time zones (expiresIn always within 900..31536000 s). Fixed after review: the line and warning sit in a status region kept mounted with empty:sr-only; 60 and 365 come from the constants; PLAN 11.6 names the API default; a due date no longer overwrites the owner's own close (closeBy state) but fills an empty Custom date; the cap names the 365-day limit; the due hint no longer contradicts the warning; the e2e checks the exact date. Left: addDays/DAY_MS repeat the kit's private date helpers.
